title: McpServer
description: A remote MCP (Model Context Protocol) server whose tools are made available to Ask Sourcebot.

name.description: Unique name of the server. Used to prefix its tool names (e.g. `jira__search_issues`) and in logs.

url.description: The URL of the MCP server endpoint.

transport.description: The transport used to connect to the server. Use `sse` for servers that only support the legacy HTTP+SSE transport.

headers.description: Optional headers sent with every request to the server (e.g. `Authorization`). Values can be plain strings or tokens resolved from environment variables or secrets.

description.description: Optional description of what the server provides. Shown to the agent to help it decide when to use the server's tools.

includeTools.description: If set, only these tools (by their original name on the server) are exposed to the agent.

excludeTools.description: Tools (by their original name on the server) that are never exposed to the agent.

enabled.description: Set to false to temporarily disable the server without removing it.
